notes:
I found two places that fit. I left out Brooklyn Children's Museum. It's open Wed to Sun, so the family could go Sept 12 and 13, but its own page doesn't say what ages it's for.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Children's Museum of Manhattan (CMOM), The Tisch Building, 212 West 83rd Street",
      "age_fit": "children ages 0-6",
      "when": "Open Sat Sept 12, Sun Sept 13 and Tue Sept 15, 10 am-5 pm; closed Mon Sept 14",
      "source_name": "Children's Museum of Manhattan"
    },
    {
      "name": "Central Park Zoo, East 64th Street and 5th Avenue",
      "age_fit": "Child (3 - 12) ticket rate; 2 and under free",
      "when": "Open daily Sept 12-15: weekends 10 am-5:30 pm, Mon-Fri 10 am-5 pm",
      "price": "Child (3-12) $16.95; adult $22.95",
      "source_name": "Central Park Zoo"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **CMOM:** 
It's on the Upper West Side, and its exhibits and programs are for children ages 0-6.
 
Daily programming includes a 10:30 am Circle Time and a 4:00 pm storytime.
 
The visitor guidelines say it's open Tuesday to Sunday from October to June.
 A line on the same page says it's open daily through Labor Day, Sept 7. I read that as Monday Sept 14 being closed, but it's worth a quick check before going. I didn't find a current ticket price on its own pages.
- **Central Park Zoo:** 
From April 2 to October 31, 2026, it's open Mon-Fri 10:00 AM-5:00 PM and weekends 10:00 AM-5:30 PM. Last entry is 1 hour before closing.
 
The page lists child (3-12) at $16.95 and adult at $22.95, with children 2 and under free.
 The zoo's page has been up for a while, so those prices may have changed. 
Tickets are managed by entry date, so book for the day you plan to go.
